title: Why Brake Checks Matter in Saskatoon
caption: With cold mornings and icy streets, making sure your brakes are in top shape helps keep you safe and can spare you an unexpected shop visit. Look out for squeaking, a soft pedal, or longer stopping distances—signs that it’s time for a quick inspection.

title: Don’t Get Stranded: Spot a Failing Battery
caption: Saskatoon winters are tough on car batteries. Slow engine starts, dim headlights, or a clicking sound when you turn the key are red flags. A simple battery test can help you avoid a tow and keep you moving.
